newsitem.title: INDIA: India Hind Ciba, IDI in venture.
newsitem.headline: India Hind Ciba, IDI in venture.

text.p: India's Hindustan Ciba-Geigy Ltd said on Thursday it had tied up with Indian Dyestuff Industries (IDI) to form a new joint venture to make dyes for textiles.
Indo Swiss Chemicals Ltd, the new firm, will be owned equally by the two companies, Hindustan Ciba said in a statement.
Hindustan Ciba is a subsidiary of the Swiss firm Ciba-Geigy AG. IDI is owned by India's Arvind Mafatlal group.

The new firm will market disperse, reactive and acid dyes manufactured by IDI and also import dyes from Ciba-Geigy. At a later stage, the venture will set up a manufacturing facility, the statement said.
